name: Cartevo – Abandoned Cart Recovery for WooCommerce
author: AyeshanFernando

sections.description:
Cartevo catches the WooCommerce carts that customers leave behind. It shows you how much you are losing, emails you about it, and gives you ways to win the customer back.

Free

  • Cart tracking: name, phone, email, cart contents, location and traffic source.
  • Dashboard with recovery rate, recovered revenue, trends, top sources and most abandoned products. Show or hide each widget.
  • Carts list with filters, sorting and a cart detail page with history and recovery link.
  • A free “Message on WhatsApp” button on each cart. It opens WhatsApp with a ready message. You send it yourself.
  • Add-to-cart popup that asks for a name and phone number, with your own texts and colours.
  • A WhatsApp chat button for your shop. It opens a chat with you; nothing is sent until the visitor presses send.
  • Works with the classic and the block-based checkout.
  • Works with WPML and Polylang: each cart remembers the shopper’s language, and the popup texts can be translated.
  • Import unfinished orders from before you installed the plugin.
  • Reports with CSV export.
  • Email alerts to you when a cart is abandoned or recovered.
  • Consent and privacy tools, including WordPress personal data export and erase.

Pro

  • Automatic WhatsApp reminders through the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API, with templates and delivery status.
  • Three-step reminder sequence with follow-ups and unique coupons.
  • Email recovery with unsubscribe handling.
  • Order messages: confirm the delivery address, let cash on delivery customers confirm or cancel, and send the tracking link.
  • With WPML or Polylang, WhatsApp messages go out in the customer’s language when the template has an approved translation, and email and order-message texts can be translated.
  • Customers who reply STOP to a reminder get no more reminders. Your Meta token and secrets are stored encrypted.
  • Your own picture beside the form in the add-to-cart popup.
  • More webhook URLs and step reports.

Requirements

WooCommerce with the classic checkout. Automatic WhatsApp sending needs your own WhatsApp Business account in Meta. Meta charges you for template messages.

External services

This plugin connects to one outside service, and only after you agree on the Freemius screen.

  • Freemius (https://freemius.com): handles the optional opt-in and the link to the separate Pro plugin. After you opt in it receives your site address, plugin version and WordPress and PHP versions. Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

The free “Message on WhatsApp” button only opens a wa.me link in your own browser. Nothing is sent to WhatsApp or Meta by the plugin. All cart and customer data stays on your own site.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, choose the zip file, install and activate.
  2. Open WooCommerce > Cartevo.
  3. In Settings, set your cut-off time and default country code.
  4. Optional: turn on the add-to-cart popup and add a webhook URL.
sections.faq:
Does it work with the block-based checkout?

Yes. On the block-based checkout it reads the name, phone and email from WooCommerce’s own cart data, so no plugin has to add fields. If you ask for consent, a tick box is added to the order section on WooCommerce versions that support additional checkout fields. On other versions customers agree through the add-to-cart popup. The classic checkout works as before.

Does the free version send WhatsApp messages by itself?

No. The free version gives you a button that opens WhatsApp with a ready message. Automatic sending is in Pro.

Do I need a special WhatsApp account?

For automatic sending, yes. You need a WhatsApp Business account in your own Meta business account.

Can it find carts abandoned before I installed it?

It can import unfinished orders (pending, failed or cancelled) from before. WooCommerce never saved the carts themselves, so those cannot be recovered.

Is it legal to message customers?

You need their permission. Use the consent note in the popup or the consent checkbox at checkout, and follow the rules in your country.

What happens to my data if I uninstall it?

Your carts and settings stay in your database until you delete the plugin; deleting it removes them.
